description: This file defines a Drupal REST resource plugin for user registration, including methods for creating user accounts, validation, and email notifications.

classes.name: UserRegistrationResource
classes.description: A Drupal REST resource plugin class for handling user registration via POST requests, including validation, account creation, and email notifications.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the UserRegistrationResource with dependencies.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the resource with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Handles the POST request to register a new user, including validation, activation, password generation, and email notifications.

methods.name: ensureAccountCanRegister
methods.description: Validates whether the user account can be registered based on current user permissions and account data.

methods.name: sendEmailNotifications
methods.description: Sends appropriate email notifications based on registration settings.
